scope: Initial curated street-food markets and public market destinations across the site's 18 Latin American countries. Ratings are omitted unless reliably sourced; location and vendor details should be checked before visiting. Photos are illustrative stock images, not confirmed photos of each venue.

streetFood.name: San Ignacio Market
streetFood.description: A lively local market for Belizean snacks, fresh fruit, tamales and everyday market food. Explore the stalls and ask vendors what is fresh that day.
streetFood.photoNote: Illustrative food photo; not a verified photo of this market.

streetFood.name: Mercado de San Juan
streetFood.address: Ernesto Pugibet 21, Centro, Cuauhtémoc, Mexico City, Mexico
streetFood.description: A historic city market known for specialty ingredients and adventurous bites; browse the food counters and regional Mexican products.
streetFood.cuisine: Mexican market food, tacos, regional specialties
streetFood.photoNote: Illustrative food photo; not a verified photo of this market.

streetFood.name: Mercado Central
streetFood.address: Near Catedral Metropolitana, Zona 1, Guatemala City, Guatemala
streetFood.description: A traditional covered market where visitors can explore Guatemalan snacks, tortillas, stews, sweets and local produce.
streetFood.photoNote: Illustrative food photo; not a verified photo of this market.

streetFood.name: Mercado Guamilito
streetFood.address: Barrio Guamilito, San Pedro Sula, Honduras
streetFood.description: A well-known market for local food and crafts; look for baleadas, pastelitos, fresh juices and Honduran home-style flavors.
streetFood.photoNote: Illustrative food photo; not a verified photo of this market.

streetFood.name: Mercado Central
streetFood.address: Centro Histórico, San Salvador, El Salvador
streetFood.description: A busy central market for Salvadoran everyday eats, including pupusas, tamales, fried snacks and fresh drinks from local vendors.
streetFood.photoNote: Illustrative food photo; not a verified photo of this market.

streetFood.name: Mercado Roberto Huembes
streetFood.address: Pista de la Solidaridad, Managua, Nicaragua
streetFood.description: A major local market where visitors can look for nacatamales, vigorón, quesillos, fruit drinks and other Nicaraguan favorites.
streetFood.photoNote: Illustrative food photo; not a verified photo of this market.

streetFood.name: Mercado Central de San José
streetFood.address: Avenida Central, San José, Costa Rica
streetFood.description: Historic market lanes filled with sodas and small food counters serving Costa Rican staples, snacks, coffee and fresh fruit drinks.
streetFood.cuisine: Costa Rican snacks, gallos, fruit drinks
streetFood.photoNote: Illustrative food photo; not a verified photo of this market.

streetFood.name: Mercado de Mariscos
streetFood.description: A popular seafood market area known for ceviche and casual seafood counters near the waterfront. Choose a busy stall and check current opening hours.
streetFood.photoNote: Illustrative food photo; not a verified photo of this market.

streetFood.name: Mercado de San Telmo
streetFood.address: Defensa 963, San Telmo, Buenos Aires, Argentina
streetFood.description: An iconic indoor market with food counters and casual bites amid antiques and neighborhood stalls; a convenient stop for exploring porteño food culture.
streetFood.photoNote: Illustrative food photo; not a verified photo of this market.

streetFood.name: Mercado Rodríguez
streetFood.address: Zona San Pedro, La Paz, Bolivia
streetFood.description: A traditional La Paz market area for everyday Bolivian food, fresh juices and hearty local snacks. Expect a busy, practical market rather than a polished food hall.
streetFood.photoNote: Illustrative food photo; not a verified photo of this market.

streetFood.name: Mercado Central de Santiago
streetFood.description: A landmark market building with seafood vendors and casual dining. It is a useful place to explore Chilean market food and classic seafood dishes.
streetFood.photoNote: Illustrative food photo; not a verified photo of this market.

streetFood.name: Paloquemao Marketplace
streetFood.description: One of Bogotá’s major markets, known for its colorful produce and traditional food stalls. Go early to experience the market at its busiest.
streetFood.photoNote: Illustrative food photo; not a verified photo of this market.

streetFood.name: La Perseverancia Marketplace
streetFood.description: A celebrated gastronomic market with regional Colombian dishes and stalls run by local cooks; a strong starting point for tasting the country in one place.
streetFood.photoNote: Illustrative food photo; not a verified photo of this market.

streetFood.name: Mercado de Santa Clara
streetFood.address: Rocafuerte and Versalles area, Quito, Ecuador
streetFood.description: Part of Quito’s traditional market culture, with cooked-food stalls and Ecuadorian market dishes. Explore local soups, hornado and fresh juices.
streetFood.photoNote: Illustrative food photo; not a verified photo of this market.

streetFood.name: Mercado 4
streetFood.description: A large, energetic market district where visitors can find Paraguayan snacks, chipa, empanadas and casual food counters among everyday commerce.
streetFood.photoNote: Illustrative food photo; not a verified photo of this market.

streetFood.name: Mercado N.º 1 de Surquillo
streetFood.address: Pasaje San Ramón, Surquillo, Lima, Peru
streetFood.description: A favorite Lima market for fresh produce and casual Peruvian food. Look for ceviche, sandwiches, juices and market counters serving local specialties.
streetFood.photoNote: Illustrative food photo; not a verified photo of this market.

streetFood.name: Mercado del Puerto
streetFood.address: Pérez Castellano 1579, Ciudad Vieja, Montevideo, Uruguay
streetFood.description: A historic market hall best known for its parrillas and casual food atmosphere; explore traditional Uruguayan grilled fare and market-side snacks.
streetFood.photoNote: Illustrative food photo; not a verified photo of this market.

streetFood.name: Mercado Agropecuario de 19 y B
streetFood.description: A neighborhood agricultural market where visitors can see seasonal produce and everyday Cuban market life. Stall availability and opening hours can vary.
streetFood.cuisine: Cuban snacks, seasonal fruit, market produce
streetFood.photoNote: Illustrative food photo; not a verified photo of this market.

streetFood.name: Mercado Modelo
streetFood.address: Avenida Mella, Santo Domingo, Dominican Republic
streetFood.description: A central market area to explore Dominican produce, local goods and nearby casual bites. Check the location and hours before setting out.
streetFood.photoNote: Illustrative food photo; not a verified photo of this market.
